It sounds like you are tired of the humdrum of your life. How long has it been since you have taken some sort of vacation? I would plan something as soon as possible.

Humdrum and a rigidly unchanging routine is no good for us humans. We are meant to be a little uncomfortable and very dynamic. Add a new challenge to your life. Find a way to break the humdrum.

is the problem with how our society has evolved and how it treats human beings?

After writing the above, I realize you are right. Societal norms have added structure to our lives, which is helpful but can also be damaging at a psychological level.

I would avoid pills for now. Try changing your behavior and readjusting your lifestyle and activities. If that does not improve things, please see a therapist and specifically request cognitive behavioral therapy.

Also, make sure to examine whether you are happy with your schooling and future career path. Do you need to change your path?

I wish you the best, my friend.
